name: SHADOW
source:
According to local fishermen, a suspicious organization occupied the island that used to be a military base in the past. The main character responds to a job application placed by the organization and as a result gets a job to violate girls every day as part of a human experiment to produce food that kills production values of sperm. Can the protagonist escape the island safely and inform mass media about this gross plan?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
据当地渔民称，一个可疑组织占领了这座过去曾是军事基地的岛屿。主角响应了该组织提出的工作申请，结果得到了一份每天侵犯女孩的工作，作为人体实验的一部分，生产杀死精子生产价值的食物。主角能否安全逃离岛屿，并将这一庞大计划告知大众媒体？
